# We’re announcing a $38M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with continued participation from Khosla Ventures, and Pear VC. · 2026-06-22T00:00:00+00:00

We’re announcing a $38M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with continued participation from Khosla Ventures, and Pear VC.

Our Co-Founder and CEO, Rohan Chopra, sat down with Ben Bergman to talk about what we’re building: AI teammates for the workflows operations teams run every day.

Invoices. Reporting. Data reconciliation. System updates. Campaign operations. The work that’s critical to the business, but still too often done by hand.

Convey has already automated over 1 million hours of work for teams across NBCUniversal, Samsara, TelevisaUnivision, ChargePoint, Unity, Faire, Savoya, and more.

This round helps us bring AI teammates to more operators, more workflows, and more enterprises ready to move beyond manual execution.

We’re grateful to our customers, investors, partners, and team for helping us build what comes next.

Manual operations had a good run. Time for AI teammates.

Read all about it in the new Business Insider exclusive–linked in comment.

But after talking to 200+ auditors, we knew this problem was so painful that we needed to try to solve it for them anyway.

Over time, somehow, "two MIT researchers" convinced audit teams at some of the most rigorous Fortune 50 companies to bet on us.

Audit is one of the last foundations of the back office still running on manual, tedious work. Nova Intelligence raises $31.5M Series A led by Chemistry to bring agentic AI to SAP's $89B migration wave

# Nova Intelligence raises $31.5M Series A led by Chemistry to bring agentic AI to SAP’s $89B migration wave

 by Paul Drecksler | May 5, 2026 | Latest E-commerce News & Updates

Nova Intelligence, a San Francisco-based startup that builds an agentic AI platform for SAP to analyze, modernize, and generate the custom code that runs payroll, supply chains, and finance functions inside Fortune 500 environments, raised a $31.5M Series A led by Chemistry, bringing total funding to more than $40M. The timing capitalizes on SAP’s mandatory deadline for customers to migrate from legacy systems to its modern S/4HANA platform by 2030, an opportunity analysts peg at more than $89B when implementation, upgrades, and ongoing support are included. An April 2025 case study with Kyndryl showed Nova’s system led to a 75% reduction in manual effort and a 50% cost reduction in modernizing a company’s SAP platform.

Paul Drecksler is the founder and editor of Shopifreaks, covering the most important stories in e-commerce.

# Ampersand closes generation gap between agents and the enterprise software stack, backed by $15 million from Bessemer Venture Partners

 Ampersand 

Oct 06, 2026, 11:59 ET

Ampersand lets agentic applications read and write inside legacy systems of record, removing the integration work that has stalled AI projects industry-wide.

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Ampersand today announced a $15 million Series A led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from existing investors Matrix and Flex Capital. New investors participating in this round also include Yelp, Tenacity Capital, CTO Fund, Mana Ventures, and prominent angel investors.
